title: Central Park Photography Tour with Local Photographer
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
Central Park is flanked by the Metropolitan Museum and the American Museum of Natural History
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Capture Central Park with your camera on this 2.5-hour photography tour. Learn the art of scouting for an image and visual editing with your expert photographer guide. You'll see the famous sights within this landmark park and enjoy the beautiful outdoors. This Central Park workshop is appropriate for all levels of photographic knowledge from beginners to advanced hobbyists.
